question.body:
A particle moves in the $x y$-plane so that its position at any time $t$, for $- pi <= t <= pi$, is given by $x(t)= sin(3 t)$ and $y(t)= 2 t$.

(a) Sketch the path of the particle in the $x y$-plane provided. Indicate the direction of motion along the path.

#image("/imgs/ap-calc-bc-2002-form-b-frq-01-diagram-01.jpg", width: 65%)

(b) Find the range of $x(t)$ and the range of $y(t)$.

(c) Find the smallest positive value of $t$ for which the $x$-coordinate of the particle is a local maximum. What is the speed of the particle at this time?

(d) Is the distance traveled by the particle from $t = - pi$ to $t = pi$ greater than $5 pi$ ? Justify your answer.
